note: Merged locals CROSSED WITH property mutation — the combination that no contract in the repo exercised. `settle` merges `na`/`nb` across an `if` whose arms rebind DIFFERENT ones, then writes all three properties from the merged results (`total` reads BOTH), and the addOutput continuation is built from the properties. Every accept pins expectedState for all three fields, so a merge that resurrects a dead pre-branch binding shows up as a wrong committed value rather than a rejected spend.

spends.note: toFirst>0: then-arm rebinds na=3+7=10; nb must survive as 5; total=10+5=15
toFirst==0: else-arm rebinds nb=5+7=12; na must survive as 3; total=3+12=15
amount=0 — the merged locals still have to be written through to the properties unchanged
tampered continuation output — the property block written from the merged locals must be committed to by hashOutputs
